title: Q6
description:
Read: Isa 63:11-14, Zec 9:11-12

The question is where is he who brought them up with the shepherd of his flock. Because of the blood of the covenant, prisoners are sent out of the pit.

a) The blessing joins the God of peace, the bringing again from the dead of the great shepherd, and the blood of the everlasting covenant. What do these two texts supply?
